title: Parish and Confession
author: Ivo Hartwell
blurb: Kestrel Reyes, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
